scripts.build:frontend: rm -rf dist/frontend && mkdir -p dist/frontend/renderer && tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/frontend/renderer/renderer.js --platform=browser --target=safari13.1 && cp src/renderer/styles.css dist/frontend/renderer/ && cp index.html dist/frontend/
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run build:frontend && npm run test:frontend && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
